gaps.sentence: They were grateful ___ the firefighters for their quick response.
gaps.explanation: grateful TO somebody FOR something. Only the first gap is checked here.

gaps.sentence: He was upset ___ losing his keys.
This app is very popular ___ teenagers.

Viewers were shocked ___ the violence in the film.
His attitude ___ work has really improved.
He's not very friendly ___ his new colleagues.
gaps.explanation: friendly WITH somebody = on good terms; a friendly person is friendly TO others.

gaps.sentence: Residents complained ___ the noise every night.
gaps.explanation: complain ABOUT something (or complain TO somebody ABOUT it).
